label: copy-phase input u when the next output is u or 0
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the fed-back input is u (100% of activations). Nearly all of it (about 93% of mass) is at steps where the token to output next is u (a repeated u u in the original, about 69% of mass) or the digit 0 (about 25%), mostly at recall_idx 3 to 5 in longer sequences. The strongest examples are the first u of a u u pair that comes late in the sequence, often after e. It never fires during the original phase or at the delimiter, and never fires on any other input token. It is sparse even when its conditions hold: only about 20% of matching steps activate, and no tested context condition (prev_tok, L, to_go) made it much more precise. So the predicate captures where the feature fires but not reliably when.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+4.42), in_tok=u (+3.54), prev_tok=e (+2.97), phase=2 & out_tok=u (+2.55), phase=2 & out_tok=0 (+2.52), out_tok=0 (+2.41). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.19), t=7 (-2.07), recall_idx=1 (-1.86), prev_tok=<DEL> (-1.86).
